item.title: ⚡ [Meeting] Telluride Board of Education Special Meeting — 2026-11-20
item.description:
Telluride School District • 2026-11-20
A special meeting with a lot packed into one Friday morning. The board takes up a first reading of Policy JJJ — a revised extracurricular eligibility policy that incorporates Colorado's statutory definitions of male and female for athletic team participation, along with updated rules for homeschooled, charter, and nonpublic-school students seeking to participate in district activities. Then the meeting moves into executive session on two fronts: selecting a superintendent search consultant (with reference-check materials protected under CORA's mandatory nondisclosure provisions), and a personnel matter involving Superintendent John Pandolfo. Coming out of executive session, the board votes on approving the search consultant and any investigative action tied to the Pandolfo matter. The board also conducts a self-assessment under GP-4-E.
⚡ Why it matters: Board takes first reading of gender-eligibility policy for school athletics.

item.title: [Fri, Nov 20] Learn DND
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Telluride Room 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM · Have you ever been curious about learning how to play Dungeons and Dragons? This is your opportunity! Join local Dungeon Master Kase in a one day campaign that is open to both experienced DND players, and folks who have never played once. This is a chance for folks to learn how DND works and jump right into a fun campaign. This is open to teens and adults.

item.title: [Thu, Nov 26] Turkey Trot 2026
item.description: 🎫 KOTO Dust off those tennis shoes and tail feathers – the Turkey Trot is back! This 5K walk/run is free and fun for the whole family (even Fido!). Sign up online in advance to be entered into a raffle, with additional prizes for the fastest male, fastest female, fastest kid under 12 and best costume. The event will take place at the intersection of Sunshine Mesa Rd. and Ilium Rd. at 9:00 a.m. on Thanksgiving morning, Thursday, November 26th, at 9:00 a.m. Sign up online at bit.ly/smcturkeytrot2026.
